customManagers.description: Operator-side CRD drift changes no file here, so no push or pull_request run can notice it; this replaces the deleted crd-staleness job. The package is PRIVATE — without a ghcr.io hostRule the lookup fails silently on renovate's dashboard and no PR appears. Keep depNameTemplate in step with OPERATOR_CHART in the Makefile.

packageRules.description: A bump edits only the Makefile, and helm-release on main fails closed on an already-published chart version — so without [skip-ci] every merged bump reddens main and pages the release webhook. The PR run already validated against the new CRDs.
